about: Finding 4 (fix/runtime-palette-scope, NUMBER PENDING): the runtime lane's front end opens the palette scope at the script's version, so a colour name it resolves through the shared Resolver (color.r/g/b/t of a constant, a color.new, a named variable) is a value equal to the host lane's column, not a runtime:lower stop; and the scope is restored however the build ends.

mutants.mutant: the runtime build opens no palette scope (the stop comes back)
the runtime build never gives the previous scope back (it leaks into the next caller)
the scope is opened at v6 whatever the script's version
mutants.expectRed: v5 and v6 give different answers
